minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210
  Video Teleconference
  The Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / Rodeo Drive/Special Events/Holiday
  Program Committee Meeting

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Tuesday, April 15, 2025
  4:00 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  April 15, 2025 / 4:00 PM
IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Sharona Nazarian, Councilmember Lester Friedman, Assistant City
  Manager Keith Sterling, Community Outreach Manager Magdalena Davis,
  Special Events Film Coordinator Patricia Betancourt, Deputy Director of
  Special Projects Chad Lynn

  1) Public Comment:

  None

  2) Request from Gearys of Beverly Hills to host Patek Philippe Grand Opening on
  Thursday, May 22, 2025:
  a. Presentation by Patricia Betancourt:
  i. Gearys is requesting a street and sidewalk closure on Thursday, May 22nd,
  2025, for the Grand Opening of Patek Philippe.
  ii. The Street closure will be on the 300 block of Rodeo Drive between Dayton
  and Brighton and will last from 9 PM on May 21st to 7 AM on May 23rd while
  the sidewalk closure will last from 6 to 9 PM on May 22nd.
  b. The event will be around 30% smaller than the Rolex event from December.
  c. Construction of the tent will start around 10 PM on the 21st and will be taken down
  prior to the street reopening at 7 AM on the 23rd.
  d. Letters of intent have been sent out to businesses on the 300 block of Rodeo
  asking for their understanding for the event as well as inviting them to it.
  e. Councilmember Friedman would like for future letters to clarify that the closure will
  primarily be on the 22nd.
  f. There are expected to be between 250 to 300 guests at the event.
  g. The Mayor would like to have additional visible security by the pick up location for
  the event.
  h. Catering will be prepared in their local locations and on the 3rd floor terrace.
  i. The Mayor has expressed her willingness to allow for sound amplified noise to go
  beyond 10 PM should they require it.
  j. Gearys is not requesting any fee waivers.
  k. Both Mayor Nazarian and Councilmember Friedman are supportive of the road
  closures.
 Highlights for April 15, 2025
Rodeo Drive/Special Events/Holiday Program Committee

  l.  They also stated that any future potential road closure proposals should be to the
  standard of this event.

  3) Adjournment:
  Date / Time: April 15, 2025 / 4:16 PM
